name: optcatalog_compute_aim_pitch_for_target
description: OptCatalog::ComputeAimPitchForTarget computes an approximate target distance and launch pitch, with out-of-range rejection unless the high-arc fallback flag is set.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the OptCatalog/zWeapon runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b0530 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as origin, stack arguments for unused direction, target, and distanceApproxOut, target-origin delta construction, Quake-style one-step fast square-root approximation using (distanceSqBits >> 1) + 0x1fc00000, gravity-zero rejection, strict in-range pitch solve, out-of-range flag 0x2000 fallback, and -1.0f rejection otherwise.
The native smoke verifies approximate distance output, in-range pitch, out-of-range rejection, high-arc fallback pitch, and gravity-disabled rejection.
